fields.body_md:
## About this programme

The **School of Computing** at KAIST offers a master's degree in computer science fields. KAIST lists these areas: computing theory, systems and networks, software design, secure computing, visual computing, AI and information service, social computing, and interactive computing.

KAIST says a master's degree generally takes **two academic years**. Instruction for international students is in English, according to KAIST.

## Fees

KAIST charges **KRW 9,559,000** a semester in 2027 (**₹6.64 lakh**). Two semesters a year come to **KRW 19,118,000** (**₹13.28 lakh**). KAIST says fees change every year.

Rupee amounts use **₹0.0694 per Korean won**. We built it from the RBI rate and the Bank of Korea closing rate for 27 November 2026. Your bank's rate will differ.

## Who can apply

You need a bachelor's degree equal to a four-year Korean degree, held or expected by the end of August 2027. Korean citizens cannot apply through this route.

KAIST asks you to find a prospective advisor in the department before you apply. If you have one, write the name on the application.

## English test

IELTS Academic **6.5**, or TOEFL iBT 4.5 (new scale) or 83 (old scale), or TOEIC 720, or TEPS 326. India is on KAIST's English-medium waiver list. Read the [KAIST page](/study-abroad/universities/kaist) for details.

## Dates for Fall 2027

Apply online from **7 January to 5 February 2027**. KAIST announces decisions on **28 May 2027**. The application fee is **USD 80**.

## Scholarships

Choose the KAIST Scholarship on the form. It can cover full tuition and a monthly stipend. Master's applicants are also considered for the KGPS: full tuition and **KRW 1,000,000** a month for 4 regular semesters. KAIST decides scholarships separately from admission.

## Sources

Official pages, checked on 28 November 2026: [KAIST Fall 2027 International Graduate Admission guide](https://www.studyinkorea.go.kr/cmm/fms/FileDown.do?atchFileId=FILE_000000000483722&fileSn=1), [KAIST yearly timelines](https://admission.kaist.ac.kr/intl-graduate/Admission/YearlyTimelines), [KAIST Scholarship](https://admission.kaist.ac.kr/intl-graduate/FinancialSupport/Scholarship/KAISTScholarship), [RBI exchange rates](https://www.rbi.org.in/) and the [Bank of Korea ECOS statistics](https://ecos.bok.or.kr).

faq_json.q: How long is the KAIST School of Computing master's?
faq_json.a: KAIST says a master's degree generally takes two academic years.

faq_json.q: What does the KAIST master's in computing cost?
faq_json.a: KRW 9,559,000 a semester in 2027, which is KRW 19,118,000 a year, about ₹13.28 lakh.

faq_json.q: Do I need an advisor before I apply to the KAIST School of Computing?
faq_json.a: KAIST says it is highly recommended. If you have one, write the advisor's name on the application.

faq_json.q: What is the KAIST application deadline for Fall 2027?
faq_json.a: 5 February 2027, 5 PM Korea time. The application opens on 7 January 2027.
